scenes.heading: Building a long-term referral pipeline from past clients

sents.d: Building a long-term referral pipeline from past clients
A closed deal isn't the end of the relationship if you want repeat and referral business.

Staying in touch with past clients after closing (a periodic check-in, a relevant market update, a small annual gesture) keeps you top of mind for both their next transaction and for referring friends and family, which is often the highest-quality lead source available.

Asking directly for a referral shortly after a successful, positive closing — while the good experience is fresh — tends to be far more effective than hoping a happy client thinks to mention you months later.
A simple system for tracking past clients and when you last reached out (rather than relying on memory) makes this sustainable as your client base grows beyond what you can track mentally.

take: Keep in touch with past clients and ask for referrals at closing.
